name: Call of Fire
summary: A shaman sees your strength in earth and sends you north to Kranal Fiss. There, you can learn the ways of fire.

sections.title: Kranal Fiss
sections.body: Kranal Fiss lives north of the Crossroads. The shaman says he is easy to find, but warns you not to go too far, lest you reach the elves' lands.

faq.answer: Kranal Fiss is a shaman in the Barrens who can teach you the ways of fire.
Kranal lives north of the Crossroads in the Barrens.

faq.q: Why am I being sent to Kranal?
faq.answer: The shaman sees your strength in earth and believes you are ready to speak with Kranal, who can teach you the ways of fire.

angles.text: As a shaman, you are sent to Kranal Fiss to learn the ways of fire after showing strength in earth.

attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Fire
